# Fate UI v0.9.3-beta3

A small prerelease that ships the CrofAI provider with every install.

## Added

- CrofAI ([crof.ai](https://crof.ai/docs), OpenAI-compatible) is now a built-in provider. It appears in the provider sign-in list and the model picker on every install — fresh or upgraded — with no setup step. Bring your own key: sign in through **Connect your AI → CrofAI → Use an API key**, or set the `CROFAI_API_KEY` environment variable. No credential ships with the app.
- Twenty CrofAI models are bundled as an offline snapshot (DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash, Kimi K3, GLM 5.x, Qwen 3.x, and more), and the catalog re-reads CrofAI's public model list on refresh so new models appear without an app update. If the catalog cannot be reached, the snapshot keeps working.
- Your own configuration always wins: a `CrofAI` block in your Fate provider `models.json` fully overrides the bundled entry.

## Verification

- Local validation: TypeScript typecheck, bundled-provider unit tests, Pi runtime regression suites, and a pristine-data-root simulation that confirms CrofAI and its models register through the real model-runtime path on a fresh install.
- GitHub Actions ran the standard four-platform pipeline: build, install, and smoke test on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64.

## Notes

- Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
